newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BT Fund Managers says European stocks attractive.
newsitem.headline: BT Fund Managers says European stocks attractive.

text.p: After focusing on Asian and U.S. stock markets over the past 10 years, investors should now turn to European markets where low levels of inflation and interest rates should help equities, BT Fund Managers said.
"The slow recovery in most European economies could turn out to be a positive factor for investing in Europe," the fund management firm said in a statement on Saturday.
"With the exception of the U.K., European governments are pursuing stimulatory policies encouraging lower interest rates and, particularly in Germany, a cheap currency," it added.

BT Fund Managers said interest rates and inflation were likely to be contained at lower levels in most continental countries in 1997. Many European companies had also demonstrated their commitment to restructuring.

"Investing in the ex-Soviet states is one of the great opportunities available to investors in Europe. The collapse of communism freed millions of new consumers and created a new breed of Eastern European entrepreneurs clamouring for capital," the fund management firm added.
BT Fund Managers Ltd represents Bankers Trust's international fund management activities in Asia.
